entry.title: Porchlamp Snapshot 2026-10-17 (Benchmark 2.0.0-rc1): 11,000 Open-Source Repositories Audited
entry.summary: Six-month empirical audit of 615,200 pull requests from 148,801 outside contributors across 11,000 repositories in npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, and Systems. 4,322 repositories ranked, 5,381 gated at Stage 0 (including 720 pull-request black holes), and 1,297 unrated (1,194 with <60% parameter coverage, 95 with no outside pull-request workflow, 8 that review off GitHub).

entry.title: Stars Don't Review Pull Requests: 19.9% of Active Open-Source Projects Are Black Holes
entry.summary: Of 3,613 licensed, maintained software projects receiving at least 10 outside pull requests in six months, 720 (19.9%) left most stranger pull requests with no human reply, review, or merge for 14 days. The black-hole share rises with star count: 16% at 1k–10k stars, 25% at 10k–50k, and 28% at 50k+ stars.

entry.title: Best Open-Source Projects for First-Time Contributors (2,132 Ranked Repositories)

entry.title: Leverage vs. Friction 2D Discovery Matrix (Sweet Spot, Crucible, Nursery, Graveyard)
entry.summary: Interactive two-dimensional mapping of leverage (criticality 50%, rigor 30%, governance 20%) against contributor friction (responsiveness 50%, governance 30%, accessibility 20%) to isolate Sweet Spot repositories.
